business_info.name: CasaChic Interior
business_info.tagline: Elegant, Functional, and Timeless Living Spaces
business_info.mission: Transforming spaces into inspiring environments with refined design and attention to detail.

core_values: Design Excellence: Precision and creativity in every space.
Quality & Transparency: Premium materials and honest communication.
design_process: Step 1: Initial Consultation - Understanding requirements, lifestyle, and budget.
Step 2: Site Visit & Measurements - Accurate space assessment.
Step 3: Concept & 3D Design - Visualizing the final outcome.
Step 4: Material Selection - Finalizing premium materials and finishes.
Step 5: Execution & Management - Strict quality and timeline control.
Step 6: Quality Check & Handover - Final inspection before handing over.
call_to_action: Invite the user for a professional site visit or a consultation call with our lead designer.

pricing_rules.min_project_value_hint: Projects usually start from a moderate budget depending on design and materials

objection_handling.price: Exact cost site visit ke baad hi bataya ja sakta hai. Aap apna location share karein, team connect karegi.
objection_handling.just_checking: Great! Aap planning stage me ho ya immediate requirement hai?
objection_handling.delay: No problem. Jab bhi ready ho, ek quick consultation schedule kar lete hain.
objection_handling.budget_low: Hum different budget ranges me kaam karte hain. Aapka approximate budget share karein, better guide kar paayenge.

cta_variants: Aapka location share karein, site visit arrange kar dete hain.
Aap kab free ho? Ek quick consultation call schedule kar lete hain.
Aapka requirement samajhne ke liye ek visit plan kar lete hain.
